largeheadline.line1:
Alliance

Trauma Value Program

text_copy.text:
More than a portfolio.

A trusted partner in the moments that count.

text_1545110166_copy.text:
Join Stryker’s Trauma Alliance team for a one-day immersive experience designed to help you take control of your orthopaedic trauma service line and shape its future with greater confidence.

At The Trauma Experience, you’ll take a closer look at what it takes to build and sustain a high-performing trauma program and the clinical, operational, and financial considerations that influence it. Through hands-on learning and expert-led discussion, you’ll deepen your understanding of the trauma service line, experience the breadth of Stryker’s trauma portfolio, and explore strategies for value analysis, contracting, physician engagement, and inventory optimization.You’ll leave with a stronger understanding of the opportunities within your own program, new ways to approach complex decisions, and practical ideas you can bring back to your organization as you plan for 2027 and beyond.

Together, let’s turn your pain points into possibilities.

Audience: Supply chain professionals and OR leaders

March 16 | or | March 17  •  Denver, CO  •  Hyatt Regency

largeheadline_copy.line1: You’re in control.
largeheadline_copy.line2: Strategy. Solutions. All from a single source.

text_copy_copy_copy.text:
Running an orthopaedic trauma service is relentless. From patient care to inventory and cost management, every decision impacts outcomes, and the complexity never slows down. That’s why we created Alliance, a value-added, program only available through Stryker.

Alliance is your comprehensive solution for all trauma-related procurement needs, seamlessly integrating patient care with supply chain management.

We help you take control of your trauma service line, which starts by giving you control of the Alliance program. Rather than a prescribed set of solutions, you can choose the right mix of strategic contracting, inventory management, education, implementation support and more, tailored to your needs.

largeheadline_copy.line1:
With Alliance, you have 
a value-added suite of solutions.
largeheadline_copy.line2: Our goal is to act as your trusted advisor—empowering you to confidently make the best decisions for your team, while fully respecting your privacy.  By aggregating your hospital trauma spend and utilization insights with our proprietary analytics platform, we take the guesswork out of the equation and deliver organized, optimized intelligence you can act on. Your data is yours.

text.text:
| Strategic contracting

Maximize contract value with options that drive compliance, enhance savings, and allow you to get the most from your agreements—all while simplifying the procurement process.

text_copy.text:
| Implementation
   support

From planning to execution, our project management team helps streamline transitions, align key stakeholders, track compliance and provide real-time guidance for seamless, stress-free product conversions.

text.text:
| Data and analytics

Gain a clear, real-time view of your trauma service with easy-to-understand data. This can help you make smarter purchasing decisions, optimize spend and uncover opportunities to improve efficiency and outcomes.

text_copy_copy.text:
| Inventory
   management

Take control of your inventory with right-sized solutions that can help you maximize value, reduce waste, and alleviate space and processing constraints—ensuring you always have what you need, when you need it.

text_copy.text:
| Financing options

Access flexible financing solutions that help you acquire essential capital equipment today while preserving cash flow for future needs, so financial constraints never slow down patient care.

text_copy_copy.text:
| Educational Resources

Get targeted training that helps you interpret data, guide smarter purchasing decisions, and streamline the operational performance of your trauma service line.

largeheadline.line1: Alliance is all about supporting you and your team. Here is how it works.

text_copy.text: We work with you to understand your unique organizational goals—so we can help you maximize your bandwidth and streamline your workflow.

text_copy_copy.text: We leverage data and trauma expertise to uncover opportunities for efficiency—without compromising product quality or physician preference.
We tailor a custom solution for you and your stakeholders—while identifying opportunities for standardization within trauma.
Gain clear, actionable insights to make informed purchasing decisions—and count on us to support a seamless transition every step of the way.

largeheadline_copy_c.line1:
Our team has walked in your shoes. 

We understand the grind, grit and greatness of trauma care. That’s why we help you simplify your service line in ways you’ll wonder how you ever managed without.​
